content.short: Kyber Network is a multi-chain liquidity hub aggregating DEX liquidity for users and dapps.
content.description: Kyber Network aggregates liquidity across decentralised exchanges so that users and integrating applications get a single point of access rather than querying venues individually. It is one of the longer-running protocols in DeFi and now appears in the Hyperliquid ecosystem alongside its established deployments.
content.meta: Aggregated DEX liquidity for users and integrating applications, now including Hyperliquid.
